title: watch: draft-gulbrandsen-jmap-ai thread
description: Arnt Gulbrandsen posted draft-gulbrandsen-jmap-ai-00 ('JMAP for AI', read-only profile) to jmap@ietf.org on 2026-11-02 ('The path forward for JMAP'). Mark replied the same day: no AI profile needed; useful work is best-practice OAuth scoping (read-only mail scope, mail without submission, short-lived revocable tokens, mailbox-limited access via RFC 9670 sharing) in draft-ietf-mailmaint-oauth-public's scope registry, and maybe better search (matching-feature capability, relevance sort). Watch replies; may come up at the IETF 127 JMAP session, Thu 2026-11-19 09:00 PT.
